findings.issue: ７日 as a date of the month is read なのか, not ななか. The item's own expl_en/expl_pt state '七日 (なのか)', so the kana contradicts the explanation.
findings.current: ななかにともだちとあう
findings.suggested: なのかにともだちとあう

findings.issue: Romaji carries the same wrong date reading: 'nanaka' should be 'nanoka' (７日 = なのか).
Token reading for ７ in the date ７日 (なのか) should be なの (with 日 = か), not なな.
１０日 (the 10th) is read とおか; the kana reads the digits as いちれい ('one-zero') + にち. The item's own expl states 'read とおか'.
findings.current: いちれいにちにしけんがあります
findings.suggested: とおかにしけんがあります

findings.issue: Romaji carries the same wrong date reading: 'ichireinichi' should be 'tooka' (１０日 = とおか).
Token reading for １０ in the date １０日 (とおか) should be とお, not いちれい (digit-by-digit 'one-zero' is never a valid reading).
Token reading for 日 in １０日 (とおか) should be か, not にち, consistent with the irregular date reading the expl itself gives.
The pattern citation is reversed: '勝つに' is ungrammatical word order; the collocation is 〜に勝つ (competition + に + 勝つ). Teaches the pattern backwards.
Same reversed pattern citation as expl_en: '勝つに' should be 〜に勝つ.
Unjustified third-person feminine subject 'she': the JP subject is implicit and en/expl_en both treat it as 'I'. Internal inconsistency that would confuse learners.
findings.current: To the shop person, she said to open the window.
findings.suggested: To the shop person, (I) said to open the window.

findings.issue: ちぇ (チェ) is romanized 'chie' as if it were ちえ; the correct romanization of チェック is 'chekku'.

Particle-function claim is off: で does not mark time ('circumstance/time'); in 夏でも, でも functions as a unit meaning 'even' (copula で + particle も). As written it teaches that で can mark when something happens.
findings.current: で marks the circumstance/time and も adds the sense of 'even'
findings.suggested: でも works as one unit meaning 'even (in)': the copula で plus the particle も

findings.issue: Same wrong particle-function claim as expl_en: で não marca tempo; でم em 夏でも funciona como unidade 'mesmo/até'.
findings.current: で marca a circunstância/tempo e も adiciona o sentido de 'até/mesmo'
findings.suggested: でも funciona como uma unidade que significa 'mesmo/até': a cópula で mais a partícula も

findings.issue: Missing accent: 'arvore' should be 'árvore'. Also the particle marker '(em-em)' is garbled — lit_en uses '(に)'; should be a single '(em)'.
findings.current: Quanto ao jardim (em-em), uma arvore pequena (objeto) plantei (passado polido).
findings.suggested: Quanto ao jardim (em), uma árvore pequena (objeto) plantei (passado polido).

findings.issue: Typo in pt gloss: missing accent and space — 'dia(do mes)' should be 'dia (do mês)'.
